results.title: Blöde Kuh
results.overview: In a remote mountain setting, Nina tries to balance the fine line between her daughter Jana’s need for affection and her prepubescent attempts for independence, giving her the freedom she desires without losing their connection to each other. But without the comforts of their usual life, tensions between mother and daughter arise as they struggle between the need for closeness and the desire for independence.

results.title: Patch
results.overview: Iva fights a loosing battle against her abusive mother who tries her hardest to control every aspect of the former's life. The way she sees it, there's only one way out of her continously deteriorating mental state: running.

results.title: They Might be Monsters
results.overview: The film follows Malcolm a middle-aged man who leads a group therapy session for dysfunctional monsters that have been kicked our or disowned from their own kind.

results.title: In My Skin
results.overview: After a heated discussion between four couples, two teams are formed (girls versus boys) and a crazy game begins. The rules are simple: for a weekend, the girls have to do the boys' activities and vice versa, and each team organizes the other team's weekend in detail. However, what seems like a simple and fun game at the end of the week turns out to be a much more complicated situation.

results.title: Krew
results.overview: A young film student joins a foreign horror film shooting in the woods, only to realize she can’t understand the language—or the dark rituals that may claim her as their final sacrifice.

results.title: Doggy-Dog World
results.overview: On the night of his band’s big come-back, a sober musician has a panic attack and locks himself in the green room with a bottle of schnapps. It’s up to his long-suffering best friend to get him through it and get him on stage.

results.title: Humid
results.overview: Over a monsoon-soaked day in a crumbling Mumbai building, a young masseuse moves quietly from body to body. Her caring touch soothes the pain of an ailing, bedridden woman, and the anxiety of a new mother, exhausted by duty and desire. As care slips toward intimacy, her hands become a conduit through which life, death, and desire pass without resolution.

results.title: Kuncen
results.overview: Darus (62) is a river guardian. He practices rituals and adheres to beliefs as a form of reciprocity with nature. One day, Darus hears news of a child missing in the river and is asked by the community to help with the search. However, his advancing age and an increasingly toxic relationship with the river have left him unable to go near it, to the point of causing him distress. Darus is trapped in a dilemma: saving the missing child or protecting himself.

results.title: Making Time for The Rehearsal
results.overview: A stage director patiently awaits his lead stars to arrive for rehearsal. As they are running late, he watches their recorded audition to remind himself he made the right choice in casting them. He wonders how far they will go.

results.title: Mind Games
results.overview: An unsettled therapist individually counsels both members of a troubled couple, becoming dangerously entangled in their relationship, to the point of her complete family uprooting.

results.title: Beautiful Evening, Beautiful Day
results.overview: Spanning decades, the film follows lovers Lovro and Nenad and their friends Stevan and Ivan, a group of gay partisans who fought against the Ustashas and Nazis. Sixteen years later, they became renowned filmmakers navigating life in post-WWII Communist Yugoslavia. As they rise to fame, they are forced to create propaganda for the regime, risking everything to protect their identities and each other. In 1957 their sexual orientation raises suspicion, and a communist party loyalist named Emir is assigned to sabotage their careers and lives, a party loyalist hiding his own secrets, whose loyalties begin to falter. The pursuit of freedom becomes a fight for survival for the artists, while Emir's beliefs are challenged.  Lush, intimate, and politically charged (and with startling parallels to our current political climate), Beautiful Evening, Beautiful Day is a poignant story of resistance — against oppression, against silence, and for the freedom to live and love without fear.

results.title: Erica
results.overview: Takumi, a man who is unpopular with women and hasn’t had a girlfriend for 23 years, happens to walk into a café one day and falls in love at first sight with Erica, a waitress. However, she is suffering from domestic violence from her boyfriend, Ryo. Takumi tries to help her, but their relationship becomes entangled with the presence of Takumi's sister, Yuka, a waitress at the café where he works part-time, and Ryo's brother, Toru.

results.title: Ravel: Piano Concerto for the Left Hand Anna Vinnitskaya in Strasbourg
results.original_title: Ravel: Concerto per la mano sinistra Anna Vinnitskaya a Strasburgo
results.overview: The Strasbourg Philharmonic Orchestra, conducted by Aziz Shokhakimov invites Anna Vinnitskaya, who won first prize at the Queen Elisabeth Competition in 2007, to perform Maurice Ravel’s Piano Concerto for the Left Hand. Ravel composed this virtuoso jazz-influenced work for pianist Paul Wittgenstein, who had lost his right arm in the First World War. Part of europiano, ARTE's special day celebrating the piano concerto across Europe

results.title: Ekshathe Alada
results.overview: When a couple realise their marriage is dead and mutually choose divorce, their families launch a relentless mission to keep them together—forcing them to fight not just for freedom, but for the radical idea that happiness matters more than a “perfect” marriage.

results.title: The Bloodline of Bathory
results.overview: A girls’ getaway at Bathory’s ruins turns deadly as a blood‑rejuvenating killer hunts them through a maze-like house.

results.title: Aquarium
results.overview: Guppy must convince five investors to fund Aquarium, an immersive virtual space designed to help people confront and process trauma - or risk losing everything.

results.title: The Tunpu
results.overview: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, two rival descendants of Ming Dynasty warriors must put aside their personal conflict over the woman they both love. As Japanese forces target their strategically vital village, they unite to transform the Guansuoling mountains into a fierce battlefield, fighting desperately to seize top-secret military maps and protect their homeland.

results.title: Summer of ‘76
results.overview: Set in the summer of 1976, we follow three teens on a roadtrip to track down the lost members of a forgotten local rock band.

results.title: Resurrection
results.overview: In the wake of a traumatic incident at a funeral, an aging widow is faced with a bizarre, impossible choice.
